attributes.source:
a0-0 = Attention(Q=pos, K=pos, V=token)
a1-0 = Attention(Q=token, K=['token', 'a0-0'], V=token)
output = Unembed(inp=a1-0)

compatibility_adaptations: provide missing my_paths directory constant during import
retain separate attention output biases in optimal-ablation vectors

stages.name: full_path
stages.renderer_adaptation: upstream full-path renderer has undefined heatmap labels; rendered equivalent expanded config with upstream QK renderer

attributes.claim: path is not a direct embedding contraction; left opaque

provenance.driver: bounded local greedy masks and auxiliary-vector KL calibration; unchanged upstream engines
compatibility_adaptations: broadcast cached positional embeddings across QK batches
QK renderer fallback for full-path renderer undefined heatmap labels

fidelity.claim: measured domain fidelity; stage execution does not establish paper reproduction or symbolic equivalence

normalization.positions: implicit positions 0..length-1 on the caller-supplied token ids
normalization.layernorm: upstream engines consume per-vertex log-variance fit on the calibration rows
normalization.acceptance: final-token argmax agreement; max_logit_error is separate and can reject a logit-level claim
